candidates.reason: The currently approved free-tier attempt was rejected because the account already uses its single free MySQL service allocation. Shared cross-project reuse remains prohibited.

Official TiDB documentation confirms MySQL protocol compatibility for common MySQL 5.7/8.0 syntax, system-root TLS using Let's Encrypt for Starter, and up to five free Starter instances per organization. Current RamaVerse schema does not use the unsupported feature families guarded by the portability test. Live provisioning, schema push, TLS connectivity, canonical Reader-data verification, integration-gate success, and exact deployed-commit QA are still required before approval.

notes: Static compatibility is not provider approval.
Do not create or configure an external provider account/service without owner approval through that provider's supported workflow.
Do not relax the dedicated-service isolation rule to bypass provider quotas.
TiDB remains unapproved until every live-validation gate in TIDB_LIVE_VALIDATION_PLAN.md has evidence.
